relationships.conditionsSummary: Signed multi-year AI compute service cap at Monarch West Virginia campus; subject to project financing and buildout milestones.
Attributed media report of unsigned credit-support discussions by NVIDIA for Nscale's Monarch campus serving Anthropic; principal and maturity undisclosed.
Signed contingent lease guarantee by NVIDIA supporting Nscale's Ward County, Texas facility lease obligations.
Signed $1.0B convertible financing commitment from NVIDIA to Nscale within the September 2026 convertible financing programme.
Announced customer commitment by Microsoft for Nscale's 50 MW Loughton, Essex UK AI data centre (16 September 2025).
Customer termination reported 19 October 2026 with company statements attributed to Microsoft and Nscale; supersedes the September 2025 announced commitment.
Nscale S-1 references NVIDIA GPU cluster architecture for Monarch; no standalone executed GPU purchase contract or unit volume is disclosed.
Disclosed multi-building data-centre hosting leases totalling 400 MW at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 1 campus in Ellendale, North Dakota.
Polaris Forge 1 400 MW IT load depends on utility substation energisation at Ellendale, North Dakota (100 MW energised, 300 MW expansion staged).
Applied Digital 7 October 2026 Form 8-K discloses lease negotiations with an unnamed 'investment-grade hyperscaler' at Polaris Forge 2 without naming the counterparty.
Secondary trade press named Oracle as the Polaris Forge 2 tenant, whereas the official Form 8-K leaves the investment-grade hyperscaler unnamed; retained as a separate conflicting assertion.
S.D. Ohio federal court order requires Wilmington, Ohio to redo three municipal rezoning ordinances before deciding on the Amazon AWS data-centre site plan.
New York Executive Order No. 62 places state DEC environmental permits for >=50 MW data centres in abeyance pending completion of the DPS Generic Environmental Impact Statement.
Intel Corporation owns and operates the Ohio One semiconductor wafer fabrication campus in New Albany, Ohio under staged capital deployment.

Anthropic Form S-1 (26 Oct 2026) & S-1/A (2 Nov 2026): Amazon holds non-voting Class N shares (capped at ~12% post-IPO) and convertible notes while simultaneously acting as enterprise cloud distributor and AWS compute supplier.

Anthropic Form S-1 (26 Oct 2026) & S-1/A (2 Nov 2026): Alphabet committed up to $40.0B in cash and performance-linked backing (Class N post-IPO ownership capped at 14.99%) while acting as Google Cloud distributor and TPU compute supplier.

Anthropic Form S-1/A (2 Nov 2026) discloses $895.4B in aggregate signed multi-year purchase and lease commitments (predominantly cloud compute and data-centre capacity as of 30 Sep 2026). Sub-contracts (such as Nscale Monarch $44.6B) are included within this $895.4B envelope and are never double-counted.

Google Cloud TPU and cloud infrastructure supply + enterprise marketplace distribution for Anthropic within the S-1/A $895.4B multi-year compute commitment envelope (principal null to prevent double-counting against the $895.4B aggregate envelope).
Intel Form 10-Q Q3 2026 discloses the $11.0B Semiconductor Co-Investment Program (SCJV) arrangement for Fab 34 in Leixlip, Co. Kildare, Ireland.

AWS Dublin hyperscale data-centre cluster depends on EirGrid Dublin Metro transmission grid capacity and CRU Large Energy Users connection policy (data centres account for 21% of national Irish electricity consumption).
Microsoft Grange Castle Dublin cloud & AI campus depends on EirGrid Dublin Metro transmission capacity and CRU Large Energy Users connection conditions.

Department of Finance Ireland (July 2026) & Central Bank of Ireland (FSR 2026 I / Governor Makhlouf 2 Nov 2026): Multinational tech sector accounts for 17% of Irish income tax and >20% of corporate tax receipts; domestic Irish banks are not directly exposed to AI valuations, but Irish MDD, investment, exports, and fiscal balances are exposed to a US AI/tech equity correction.

Eamon Quinn (The Irish News, 8 Nov 2026 discovery article): Connects US AI compute buildout and debt-financed valuations to Ireland's power-hungry data-centre grid strain and fiscal exposure. Retained strictly as reported discovery context; never promoted alone as a confirmed relationship.
